Default PBR material textures for GENESIS.

Source: ambientCG Metal019 (https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Metal019)
License: CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain) — https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Installed maps (1K):
  base_color.jpg          — Color / albedo (sRGB)
  metallic_roughness.jpg  — glTF packed (G=roughness, B=metalness)
  normal.jpg              — OpenGL tangent-space normal
